name: Naibabiji Coming Soon & Maintenance Mode
author: 奶爸建站笔记

sections.description:
Naibabiji Coming Soon & Maintenance Mode is a professional-grade WordPress plugin that provides elegant Coming Soon and maintenance mode pages for your website. Whether you’re developing a new site, performing system maintenance, or preparing for a major product launch, this plugin delivers a professional temporary page experience for your visitors.

Core Features

🎨 Modern Responsive Design
* Perfect compatibility with desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
* Modern interface design that enhances your brand image
* Automatic display of your website logo (if configured)

🔐 Smart Password Protection System
* Optional password access functionality
* 24-hour validity period with secure cookie mechanism
* Backward compatibility support for old and new cookie formats
* Uses WordPress standard security hashing algorithms

⚙️ Flexible Management Settings
* One-click enable/disable Coming Soon mode
* Customizable page title and content
* Rich text editor with HTML content support
* Custom CSS style editor
* Real-time status display panel

🔍 SEO Optimization Features
* Automatically adds noindex and nofollow meta tags
* Prevents search engines from indexing temporary pages
* Cache control header settings
* Follows SEO best practices

👨‍💼 Administrator Privileges
* Administrators automatically bypass the Coming Soon page
* Preview page effects from the backend
* Detailed plugin status information

Use Cases

  • Website Development Phase – Display professional Coming Soon pages before site completion
  • System Maintenance Periods – Inform visitors that the site is under maintenance
  • Product Launch Announcements – Build anticipation for upcoming products or services
  • Private Website Protection – Add access control for private or internal websites
  • Major Update Preparation – Temporarily hide the website before major updates

Technical Features

  • Lightweight Design – Optimized code structure that doesn’t affect website performance
  • Secure and Reliable – Follows WordPress security standards and best practices
  • Multi-language Support – Complete internationalization support with Chinese translation included
  • Strong Compatibility – Compatible with mainstream WordPress themes and plugins
  • Standardized Development – Follows WordPress coding standards

Privacy Policy

Data Collection Policy

This plugin strictly follows privacy protection principles:

  • No Personal Data Collection – The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any user personal information
  • Functional Cookies – Only uses necessary functional cookies for authentication when password protection is enabled
  • Local Storage – All settings data is stored only in your WordPress database
  • No Third-party Services – Does not depend on any external services or APIs
  • GDPR Compliant – Fully complies with GDPR and other privacy regulations

Cookie Usage Information

When password protection is enabled, the plugin sets a secure cookie:
* Purpose: Verify that the user has entered the correct password
* Validity: 24 hours
* Security: Uses WordPress standard encryption algorithms
* Auto Cleanup: Automatically expires after the validity period

Support

Getting Help

For technical support, feature suggestions, or bug reports, please contact us through the following channels:

  • WordPress Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/naiba-coming-soon/
  • Developer Website: https://blog.naibabiji.com
  • Email Support: blog@naibabiji.com
  • Documentation Center: https://blog.naibabiji.com/files/wordpress-plugins/naiba-coming-soon.html

Troubleshooting

Before contacting support, please check the FAQ section first, as most common issues have detailed answers there.

Feedback & Suggestions

We value feedback from every user. Your suggestions help us continuously improve the plugin’s functionality.

Developer

About the Developer

Naibabiji is a technical team focused on WordPress tutorials and plugin development. We are committed to providing high-quality website building solutions for Chinese WordPress users.

  • Official Website: https://naibabiji.com
  • Development Team: Naibabiji Technical Team
  • Contact Email: blog@naibabiji.com
  • Tech Blog: https://blog.naibabiji.com/

Other Works

We have also developed multiple practical WordPress plugins and themes. Please visit our official website to learn more about our products.

Thank you for choosing the Naiba Coming Soon plugin! If you find this plugin helpful, please give us a five-star rating in the WordPress plugin directory – it would be the greatest encouragement for us!
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to “Plugins” > “Add New” in your WordPress admin panel
  2. Search for “Naibabiji Coming Soon”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Navigate to “Settings” > “Coming Soon” to configure the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file and extract it
  2. Upload the naiba-coming-soon folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” page in WordPress admin
  4. Go to “Settings” > “Coming Soon” to configure

Quick Setup

  1. Enable Mode: Check “Enable Coming Soon Mode”
  2. Set Content: Customize page title and content
  3. Password Protection (Optional): Enable password protection and set access password
  4. Save Settings: Click “Save Settings” to complete configuration
  5. Preview Effect: Visit your website in a private/incognito window to see the effect
sections.faq:
How do I enable the Coming Soon page?

Go to “Settings” > “Coming Soon” in your WordPress admin panel, check the “Enable Coming Soon Mode” option, and save the settings.

Can administrators still access the website normally?

Yes, users with administrator privileges will always see the normal website content and can bypass the Coming Soon page for website management.

How does the password protection feature work?

When password protection is enabled, visitors need to enter the correct password to access the website. After successful verification, the system sets a secure cookie valid for 24 hours, eliminating the need to re-enter the password during this period.

Does the plugin affect SEO?

The plugin is SEO-friendly and automatically adds noindex and nofollow meta tags to prevent search engines from indexing the Coming Soon page, without affecting your website’s SEO performance.

Can I customize the page appearance?

Absolutely! You can customize the page title, content, and add custom CSS styles to match your brand style. The plugin also automatically displays your website’s logo if configured.

Does the plugin affect website performance?

No. The plugin uses a lightweight design with optimized code that only loads necessary resources when needed, without negatively impacting website performance.

How do I preview the Coming Soon page?

After saving settings and enabling Coming Soon mode, visit your website in a private/incognito browser window to preview the effect. Administrators will still see the complete website in normal mode.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, the plugin fully supports WordPress internationalization features, includes complete Chinese translation, and can be translated into other languages.

How secure is the password protection?

The plugin uses WordPress standard security mechanisms, including nonce verification, data sanitization, and secure hashing algorithms, ensuring the password protection feature is secure and reliable.

Does the plugin collect personal data?

No. The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. It only uses functional cookies for authentication when password protection is enabled.
sections.changelog:
2.1

  • Critical Bug Fix – Fixed infinite loop issue in password verification system that prevented users from accessing content after entering correct password
  • Cookie System Overhaul – Completely redesigned cookie validation mechanism using JSON-based data structure for improved reliability
  • Performance Optimization – Reduced password verification time from seconds to milliseconds by eliminating unnecessary time window loops
  • Security Enhancement – Implemented more secure cookie storage with base64 encoding and improved hash validation
  • Backward Compatibility – Added legacy cookie format support to ensure seamless transition for existing users
  • Code Refactoring – Streamlined verification logic and reduced computational overhead for better server performance
  • User Experience – Eliminated frustrating password re-entry loops, providing smooth access after successful authentication

2.0

  • Major Refactoring – Complete rewrite of plugin core code for improved performance and stability
  • Security Enhancement – Upgraded password protection mechanism using WordPress standard security hashing
  • User Experience Optimization – Brand new admin interface design that’s more intuitive and user-friendly
  • Feature Enhancement – Added real-time status display, plugin information panel, and other new features
  • Compatibility Improvement – Optimized compatibility with the latest WordPress versions
  • Code Optimization – Follows WordPress coding standards for improved code quality
  • Documentation Enhancement – Updated user documentation and developer documentation
  • Translation Updates – Improved Chinese translation and optimized multi-language support

1.0.0

  • Initial Release – Basic Coming Soon page functionality
  • Password Protection – Basic password access control feature
  • Responsive Design – Support for various devices and screen sizes
  • Multi-language Support – Internationalization features and translation files
  • SEO Optimization – Automatic addition of search engine optimization tags
